exstinctĭo (ext- ), ōnis, f. exstinguo. —Prop.,
I.a putting out; trop., extinction, annihilation (very rare): “supremus ille dies non exstinctionem sed commutationem affert loci,” Cic. Tusc. 1, 49, 117 : vitae, Cic. ap. Aug. de Trm. 14 fin. (Cic. Hortens. Fragm. 90).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
